objective: Make stable promotion prove the exact tested commit is a reviewed merged dev commit, with no public test replacement.
acceptanceCriteria:
An unmerged feature SHA, unreachable dev SHA, missing review evidence or dirty/mutated candidate cannot advance stable.
No production argument can substitute or skip the mandatory full suite.
A failed suite, auth/network failure or divergent/concurrently advanced stable produces no unsafe push.
A valid merged SHA promotes fast-forward and produces a receipt tied to that exact tested tree.
nonGoals: No target synchronization, host deployment, repository-setting changes or hand edits to Bazzite.
risks: risk:high: Resolve candidate SHA from a merged dev PR and verify current origin/dev reachability; merge, squash and rebase histories must be explicitly supported by evidence, never assume a single merge commit. Use an isolated clean candidate checkout and the committed catalog/full-suite paths. Remove public -TestScript substitution; test small internal pure functions with fixtures and stub executables on an isolated test PATH rather than adding production bypass flags. Always validate full suite and verify candidate identity/tree before pushing an explicit SHA to stable. Preserve fast-forward requirement and handle concurrent stable advancement as a refusal. Distinguish successful remote lookup with absent stable from failed auth/network lookup; only genuinely absent stable permits bootstrap. Write a versioned promotion receipt with candidate SHA, merged PR, dev SHA, old/new stable SHA, validation artifacts and outcome. Output/report paths stay outside candidate tracked content.
suggestedWorkBreakdown:
Refactor candidate selection and ancestry checks around the PR eligibility/evidence contract.
Remove public test-script override and replace current happy/failing promotion test seams.
Run catalog/full suite against the isolated immutable candidate, recheck identity and push explicit SHA.
Document bootstrap, fetch failure, concurrent promotion and rollback-via-revert behavior.
unresolvedQuestions: Awaiting explicit human approval of the recorded high-risk plan.
